notes.notes: [h3]Pocket & Zooom Ver.1.3.0.1933[/h3][p][/p][p]We have released Update Ver.1.3.0.1933 for Pocket & Zooom.[/p][p]This Update includes minor bug fixes and the addition of the following features.[/p][p][/p][p]・Improved clarity on the cause of game over.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45482907/14cf9ade092f297975dc79dbe602ebe92d1c6f58.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]・Add an operation guide when using the "Change Destination" and "Change Route" cards.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45482907/1e4b8fe3562d7fd76e5717c412a0dee248503ea1.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Pocket & Zooom | Release Date: 27 March, 2025
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45482907/49e88285485b229754563c55c2fcedcf6a3ac4ed.png[/img]

It's finally here!
Pocket & Zooom is coming on 27 March, 2025(PDT)!

This is a puzzle game where you give instructions to aircraft and guide them to their destinations.

Add to your Wishlist and receive updates!
